title_sq: VILE PER SHITJE NE LIQENIN E FARKES
description_sq:
Prona ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja prane liqenit te Farkes. Kompleksi perbehet nga 14 vila dhe nje godine te organizuar ne apartamente premium. Vila organizohet ne 3 kate
- Kati -1 : 58.7 m2 dhe sherben si vend parkimi per dy automjete dhe depo,
- Kati 0 : 101.8 m2 dhe organizohet ne ambient ndenje, ambient gatimi dhe nje tualet
- Kati 1 : 97.3 dhe organizohet ne tre dhoma gjumi ku nje me Garderop , dy tualete dhe ballkon perimetrik qe aksesohet nga te gjitha dhomat.
Siperfaqja e parceles eshte 294m2 .
Vilat jane ne fazen perfudimtrare ku aktuasht po punohet me rifiniturat dhe rregullimin e ambienteve te perbashketa.
Si zone ne zhvillim dhe investime publike ka ne perberje pedonale rreth 6 Km perreth liqenit, piste bicikletash, korsi vrapimi dhe pjese te ndryshme relaximi dhe aktivitetesh fizike.
Nje prone ideale per banim por gjithashtu dhe per investim.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni !!
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN FARKA LAKE
description_en: The property is located in one of the newest residences near the Farka lake. The complex consists of 14 villas and a building organized into premium apartments. The villa is organized on 3 floors - Floor -1: 58.7 m2 and serves as a parking space for two vehicles and a warehouse, - Floor 0: 101.8 m2 and is organized into a living room, kitchen area and a toilet - Floor 1: 97.3 and is organized into three bedrooms, one with a wardrobe, two toilets and a perimeter balcony that is accessed from all rooms. The surface of the plot is 294m2. The villas are in the final stage where they are currently working on refinishing and arranging the common areas. As an area under development and public investment, there are about 6 km of pedestrian paths around the lake, bicycle tracks, running lanes and various areas for relaxation and physical activities. An ideal property for residence but also for investment. For more information contact us!!
